description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs lines 138-145: the revocation loop calls check_revocation(cert, issuer) only when chain.get(i+1) is Some. The last cert in chain[] (the one directly issued by the trust anchor) is never checked because its issuer is the trust anchor, not chain[i+1]. The comment on line 141-143 acknowledges this. However, this means any certificate directly issued by the trust anchor — typically an intermediate CA — is never revocation-checked. If a CA cert is compromised and its serial appears in the trust anchor's CRL, this implementation will not detect it. The limitation must be documented in verify_chain's rustdoc (it currently is not).
title: pkix-chain verify_chain skips revocation for cert directly issued by trust anchor
